text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The one crowned Derby Umamusume
is neither the Monster nor a Satono!!
A new heroine has etched her name into history!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like we both lost.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... How pathetic of me.
Even though I prepped so thoroughly for this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (—I'm sorry, Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (In the end, it seems I got way too fixated on my rivalry with Duramente-san.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (...Letting the victory slip away was my fault.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...The final straight.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"On the final straight,
all I could think was, 'As long as I beat you, that's enough.'"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Though my duty was to take first place,
I allowed myself to indulge in such thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. It's frustrating, for both of us.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —I have my sights set on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Held in France, it is the world's most prestigious and historic stage.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I decided it ever since my debut.
My mission is to prove the worth of this bloodline to the world.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Our prime as athletes is limited.
There's no guarantee we'll still be at our peak
next year or the year after.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
We can't afford to waste time.
We have to challenge ourselves while the opportunity exists.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "That is why I choose: whether to enter my grand ambition, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, or run in the Kikuka Sho to battle for the strongest of this generation."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —However...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—However, I will challenge you again.
To surpass what I believe to be the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"When that time comes, try standing
in my way once more."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...Neither I nor you desired a conclusion like this."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...It's a promise,
Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Like a puppet with its strings cut,
Satono Crown collapses.
Her battered body bore witness to the fierce battle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days after that desperate struggle.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Gah!

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~... I see.
This leg definitely has more muscle on it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chiropractor, whom Satono Crown says has taken care of her for years,
turns to face me while pressing on her lower back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...To clear away the anxiety
I felt when I collapsed at the Derby."

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Regarding Crown-san's fatigue,
it might be caused by a 'misalignment.'

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A pelvic tilt had been noticed before.
...However, it shouldn't have been this severe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Because I didn't have time to go.

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Honestly, Milady.
I understand you have been busy entering the Classic division, but still.

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text:
If an imbalance occurs somewhere in the body,
that distortion will eventually spread
to affect the entire body.

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text:
In an unconscious effort to compensate for that misalignment, you tense up and build strange muscle.
In the end, it just leads to unnecessary fatigue—...

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text: It turns into this kind of pain, you see!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Kya!?
Hot-hot-hot-hot-hot-hot-hot!!"
choice_data_list: Conversely, it should be possible to cure that as well, right?

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text:
The foundation surrounding the bones—
If we train the muscles in a well-balanced manner...
choice_data_list: So if I start over from the basics...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
Let's set aside a rest period.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Let me guess what you're thinking, Trainer: "Start over from the basics? At this stage?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Even if it means throwing away your shot at the Classic autumn campaign?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, I understand how you feel.
Especially after achieving such results in the Derby.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"You're thinking it too, aren't you?
'I want to see Satono Crown achieve even greater things.'"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Well, it's the same for me too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: And besides... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Try standing in my way once more.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—I haven't fully savored it yet.
The sweet taste of that showdown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: If I'm gonna become a celebrated Umamusume, I gotta be able to beat the strongest at the very least.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown's eyes blaze with intensity.
And the goal she set
was the Senior Class GⅡ Kyoto Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After taking a brief rest to catch her breath, she will spread her wings for the middle-distance GⅠ races—heading straight for the spring stage where the senior-class powerhouses gather.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —From now on, it's time to prepare and get everything in order.
